reason: A monitoring and visualization plugin that aggregates LLM token usage by day, provider, model, session, and sub-agent, then presents dashboards, history, exports, and /usage results; it also optionally displays estimated costs and DeepSeek balance.

summaries.zh: 按自然日统计并可视化 LLM token 用量，支持按提供商、模型、会话和子代理查看，并提供历史趋势、CSV 导出及 /usage 查询。
summaries.en: Tracks and visualizes daily LLM token usage by provider, model, session, and sub-agent, with history views, CSV export, and /usage queries.

capabilities: Reads session event logs to collect model token usage
Aggregates and persists usage statistics on disk
Provides usage dashboards, history views, CSV export, and a chat command
Exposes same-origin HTTP endpoints for usage data
Optionally requests DeepSeek account balance using a configured API key
